title: Government Hospital Pharmacist Under EOW Scanner Over Alleged Rs 2.13 Crore Disproportionate Assets

Indore: The Economic Offences Wing (EOW) of Madhya Pradesh police raided the premises of a pharmacist of a government hospital in Indore on Wednesday and uncovered assets worth nearly twice his legitimate income, officials said.

According to a press release issued by the EOW, a complaint was received against Rakesh Gorkhe, a pharmacist at the Government Maharaja Yashwantrao Hospital (MYH), claiming that he had amassed assets disproportionate to his income through alleged corruption.

After investigating the complaint, the EOW raided Gorkhe’s premises.

According to the release, Gorkhe, who joined the government service in 2007, has earned a total legitimate income of Rs 1.11 crore from his salary, while his movable and immovable assets are valued at Rs 2.13 crore.

During the raids, documents indicating ownership of a two-storey house and four plots of land in Indore were recovered, it said. Papers also showed that a payment of Rs 6.7 lakh had been made for the purchase of another plot of land, it said.

Officials said Gorkhe’s wife has been working as a librarian at the city’s government dental hospital since 2010, and the couple’s income and expenses are being investigated.

An EOW official said, “We have received information from Gorkhe’s passport about a trip to Thailand in October 2023, but no record of government permission for this trip has been found. The expenses incurred on the foreign trip will be assessed and included in the investigation.” The official said that property documents, bank passbooks, registry copies, and Rs 1.51 lakh in cash were recovered from Gorkhe’s home during the raids.

He said that a case has been registered against the pharmacist under the Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act, and an investigation is underway.

Source : PTI
